core.title: 19 Inch C Shape Door Pulls, Pair, Hager 921B26

text.description_html:
Hagar 921B, 19 Inch "C" Door Pulls in Polished Chrome

This "C" Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes Contact Us for more information.

Specifications: Hagar 921B "C" Door Pull

  • Height: 19"
  • Width: 1-3/8"
  • Projection: 1-1/2"
  • Exterior Radius: 9-1/2"
  • Interior Radius 8-1/8"
  • Mounting Holes: 17-1/2" Center to Center
  • Finish: Polished Chrome
  • Material: Solid Brass

Packaged with 2 door pull handles and includes the hardware for back to back mounting on 3" thick wood doors.

*Sold as a Pair (2 Pulls)
